title: Bye Bye Perspective API: Lessons for Building and Governing Measurement Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2604.25580v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Perspective API closes at the end of 2026, removing the de facto standard for toxicity measurement and exposing researchers' dependence on a tool they did not control. Drawing on this case, we argue that a research field must build and govern its own measurement infrastructure rather than borrow it. Surveying 241 papers that use or study Perspective, we show what depending on it cost the research community: claims reaching past what the tool could support, results that shifted when its model was silently retrained, and disparities researchers could measure but not explain. These failures were amplified throughout the LLM lifecycle, where Perspective supplied the labels, filtered the corpora, and graded the systems trained on each, rewarding errors rather than catching them. translated_title: 再见，Perspective API：构建与治理测量基础设施的经验教训
translated_abstract: Perspective API 将于 2026 年底关闭，这将移除毒性测量的事实标准，并暴露出研究者对一款自己无法控制的工具的依赖。基于这一案例，我们认为一个研究领域必须构建并治理自己的测量基础设施，而不能只是借用它。通过调研 241 篇使用或研究 Perspective 的论文，我们展示了这种依赖给研究界带来的代价：超出工具所能支持的结论、当其模型被悄悄重新训练时随之改变的结果，以及研究者能够测量却无法解释的差异。这些失败在整个大语言模型（LLM）生命周期中被进一步放大——Perspective 在其中提供标签、过滤语料库，并为基于这些语料库训练的系统评分，奖励错误而非发现错误。为了在该工具关闭后仍能对其进行研究，我们发布了来自 77 个数据集的 590 万条文本片段的 Perspective 评分。我们进一步提出了十项要求……
tldr: 随着毒性测量的事实标准 Perspective API 即将关闭，本文通过分析 241 篇依赖该工具的论文揭示其带来的测量偏差与错误放大问题，主张研究领域必须自主构建并治理测量基础设施，并发布 590 万条文本的 Perspective 评分数据以保持该工具的可研究性。
en_tdlr: With the shutdown of Perspective API, this paper draws lessons from 241 dependent papers to argue that research fields must build and govern their own measurement infrastructure, and releases 5.9 million Perspective scores across 77 datasets to keep the instrument open to study.
